Not all it's cracked up to be.... Great apps are in the little details that make the difference. I have been using the app for 14 days straight. I have walked the same path every day and the numbers don't add up. I understand that I will not walk the exact amount every time but there are a lot of things that don't make sense. Lets start with what works. The timer. The step counter is fairly consistent considering I walk at different paces so the number of steps will be different. Here's where it gets interesting, Distance. Depending on the given day I had walked anywhere from 1.79 miles to 3.2 miles over the same route. The most interesting aspect is the final day of the test I walked the route as fast as I could. I cut 10 minutes off my time but the speed of the walk was slower than any other walk and the average speed was almost half of my regular speed walks.

The history aspect is also irritating. Some days the session is saved like you would expect. The date & time of the session. Sometimes the session will save over a 24 hour period from the stop time of the previous session & the start time next session.

Hopefully these issues for me can be resolved. Until then I'll be looking for a better app.
